$comment: Documentation-only shape reference for .context-maintainer/manifest.json. Not enforced via a jsonschema runtime dependency — see manifest.py for the actual hand-rolled validation logic.
last_synced_at: ISO-8601 timestamp string, or null if never synced
last_verified_commit: git commit SHA string, or null if the repo has no commits yet
context_maintainer_version: semver string, matches the CLI's __version__ at last write
repomix_version: string reported by `repomix --version`, or null if unavailable
mcp_language_server_configured: bool, or null if never checked
